title: test_fragment TOFU hold-down boundary uses hardcoded 59.999/60.0 literals
description: Wave-1 review (correctness, P3): python/tests/schc/test_fragment.py:2412,2415 hardcode 59.999/60.0 instead of AUTHENTICATED_HOLD_DOWN_SECONDS (reassembly.py:41), which the file already imports and four sibling tests use (lines 2355, 2530, 2628, 2698). If the spec constant changes, this test fails with a confusing RxFrame-vs-ReceiveError mismatch instead of tracking the constant. Use AUTHENTICATED_HOLD_DOWN_SECONDS - 0.001 and AUTHENTICATED_HOLD_DOWN_SECONDS. Discovered-from wave 1 bead project-LICHEN-worker6-hg27.
close_reason: Fixed in wave 1 follow-up: casefold guard + aliased regression, parametrize entry, fsync-ordering pin, hold-down constants, wait_for timeouts + ctime_ns. Suites green (44+178+130).
